property_summary: For any caller and amount, after Collect returns successfully the caller's balances mapping is decreased by the withdrawn amount (reference keeps the balance reduced even if the recipient re-enters); the mutant delaying the subtraction until after the external call allows a reentrant recipient to re-enter and cause Collect to complete while the mapping does not reflect the withdraw, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Move the balances subtraction to after the external call, so balance is reduced only if the call succeeds and returns (state update delayed until after call).
